candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to words related to major world religions and their adherents.
Religious terminology and ecclesiastical concepts, particularly associated with Catholicism and sacred rituals.
This vector represents the concept of joyful gatherings, events, and festive occasions.
This vector represents verbs of internal mental states, cognitive processes, and emotional attitudes.
This feature vector represents adverbs and adjectives of frequency, habituality, and general occurrence.
Personal and possessive pronouns indicating grammatical person, gender, and possession.
This vector represents cultural practices, social traditions, and structured communal events.
The tokens relate to Islamic culture, geography, and religious terms, alongside Romanian and Arabic linguistic elements.
This vector activates for titles, honorifics, and geographical or religious proper name prefixes associated with holiness, royalty, or reverence.
Quantifiers and indefinite determiners expressing amount or extent.
